name: Charities and Non-Profit Organisations Misuse for Money Laundering
description: Use of charities and NPOs, or their accounts and fundraising channels, to hold, mix or move illicit funds that appear as donations, grants or program spending. This typology covers the money laundering angle only.

sources.text: FATF, Best Practices: Combating the Abuse of Non-Profit Organisations (Recommendation 8) (2015; updated 2023)
FATF, Risk of Terrorist Abuse in Non-Profit Organisations (2014) and related guidance (general)
Charity regulators' published guidance on financial crime (general)

exposure.rationale: Charity accounts and donation channels used for mixing and moving funds.

indicators.name: Donations inconsistent with fundraising profile
indicators.desc: Transactions or withdrawals are uncharacteristic of, or inconsistent with, the customer's known profile, income or expected activity.
indicators.ctx: Receipts out of line with size, reach or history of the NPO.

indicators.name: Large anonymous or cash donations
indicators.desc: Donations are made through cash, anonymous collections or structured amounts.
indicators.ctx: Substantial cash donations without donor identity.

indicators.name: Funds quickly moved to unrelated parties or abroad
indicators.desc: Funds received into an account are forwarded onward within a very short period, often in near-equal amounts and leaving minimal balance.

indicators.name: Opaque governance or controllers
indicators.canon: Beneficial owner or controller cannot be identified
indicators.desc: Ownership or governance is opaque and no natural person who owns or controls the entity can be identified after reasonable effort.
indicators.ctx: Unclear trustees, control or beneficial owners.

indicators.name: Activities do not match stated objects
indicators.canon: Activities do not match stated objects

indicators.name: Unregistered or unlicensed fundraising
indicators.desc: Raising funds without registration or authority.
indicators.ctx: Raising funds without registration or authority.

indicators.name: Connections to high-risk jurisdictions
indicators.canon: Counterparty or flows in higher-risk jurisdictions with weak AML controls
indicators.desc: Funds, counterparties or institutions are located in jurisdictions with weak AML supervision, sanctions exposure or limited VASP regulation.
indicators.ctx: Programs in high-risk areas without controls.

indicators.name: Fake or inflated beneficiaries and invoices
indicators.canon: Fake or inflated beneficiaries and invoices
indicators.desc: Payments to suppliers with weak evidence.
indicators.ctx: Payments to suppliers with weak evidence.
